per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must use standard authentication frameworks, container orchestration patterns, and monitoring agents to avoid special support contracts.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be tolerant of latency and have a sensible caching or offline approach for field users with flaky connectivity.
The system must support degraded functionality for offline use, allowing parts lookup and marking candidates, but requiring connectivity for committing finalized estimates.
The system must handle approximately fifteen hundred concurrent users at peak.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Parts searches must return results in under fifteen seconds end-to-end, measured at the 95th percentile.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Facility lookups must return results in under eight seconds from a user click, measured at the 95th percentile.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be available with ninety-eight percent uptime during business hours and when adjusters are working.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support both shared database with row-level access controls and separate schemas or databases for tenant isolation.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must integrate with the corporate identity provider using SAML-based SSO for the web portal and OAuth tokens for API access from mobile clients.
